normative_extracts.quote: Server Functions create public HTTP endpoints and should be treated with the same security assumptions as any public API route, validating both authentication and arguments.

pipeline_phases: Build-Time Action ID & Client Stub Extraction
Server Action Lookup, Auth Check & Streamed Response
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Bundlers compile 'use server' functions into opaque action IDs with encrypted bound closures, dispatching POST requests that return updated UI trees in one round-trip.

production_failures.symptom: Unauthorized data mutation via replayed POST requests
production_failures.root_cause: Assuming a Server Action hidden inside an admin component cannot be invoked directly without checking session permissions inside the action body.
production_failures.mitigation: Always authenticate the caller and verify resource ownership at the top of every 'use server' function.

production_failures.symptom: Runtime crash: 'Only plain objects can be passed to Server Functions'
production_failures.root_cause: Invoking a Server Action with a DOM SyntheticEvent, class instance, or function reference that fails wire serialization.
production_failures.mitigation: Extract plain primitives or FormData before calling the Server Action.
